items.description: Text search is important for client-side filtering and autosuggests. Naive has no sensible order on the results, and ignoring word boundaries gives unexpected matches like spa -> newSPAper. First, here are some libraries that prioritize word matches:

items.title: wade
items.description: Also similar, (compare)

items.title: js-search
items.description: Feature-rich and customizable: multi-field indices, stop words, custom stemmers and tokenizers.

items.title: libsearch
items.description: Index-free search (slower, but easier to use) with sane ordering

items.title: ndx
items.description: Similar to js-search, differs in ranking and is less strict for multi-word queries (compare). Supports field weights.

items.title: Text Search

items.description: Fuzzy search is another take on inexact matching — the words can be modified. First, we have libraries that only allow insertion: spacecat -> SPACECrAfT. Not perfect for general-purpose text search, but great for filename, command, or URL lookups.

items.title: fuzzysearch
items.description: One string at a time, does not compute score / rank.

items.title: fuzzy
items.description: Index-free, can highlight matches.

items.title: liquidmetal
items.description: Quicksilver algorithm, prioritizes matches at start of word for command abbreviations (e.g. -> ). One string at a time.

items.title: fuzzy-search
items.description: With stateful index.

items.title: quick-score
items.description: Another quicksilver-based lib, tweaked for long strings. Built-in list filtering and sorting, or 1.2 kB for single-string scoring.

items.title: fzy.js
items.description: Matches one string at a time, tree-shakeable scores and match highlighting. total, or ~150 bytes for only.

items.title: Fuzzy search
